# Reddit 账号预热与发帖：英文原文

作者：Nicholas Dulait（@NicholasDulait）  
原帖：https://x.com/nicholasdulait/status/2115756883050918215?s=46  
发布时间：2026-10-29 18:45（北京时间）

On Reddit, I sell nothing for the first 3 days, and 10 of my 12 posts went over 50K views.

The best one did 168K.

A new account that posts a link is a ban waiting to happen. So before my first post, I warm the account up:

1. Create it with an email that is at least a few months old and has real activity. A brand-new email that starts posting right away gets flagged as spam.

2. Hide your profile activity: Settings > Profile > Content and activity > Hide all. Redditors check your profile before they upvote, to see if you're marketing.

3. Get to at least 10 account karma before your first post.

4. Pick 5 subreddits. Don't pick them by size, pick the ones Google already ranks on your best keywords, because that's where your buyers search.

5. For 3 days, open your 5 subreddits, find posts from the last few hours that are gaining traction, and leave 1 useful comment in each. 5 a day, 15 in total, zero self-promotion.

A useful comment shares a relevant experience, answers the question someone asked, adds a specific insight, or proves you read the post.

Then read every rule in the sidebar before each post. One violation can get you banned for good.

That's it. The 15 comments nobody sees are what make the posts everyone sees.
